title: Delivery receipt test vectors
description: Shared cross-impl test vectors for delivery receipts. Vectors needed: (1) piggybacked ack_through in reply message, (2) explicit standalone receipt after timeout, (3) ack_through covering multiple messages (ID range), (4) receipt as custody-transfer message (S+C flags set on receipt itself). Place in test/vectors/. Spec: 12-apps.md §18.1.2.
